title: Why Africa will lead the next wave of tech innovation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Africa’s tech innovation is inevitable due to its growing youth population and rapid mobile adoption. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Africa already leads in mobile money and AI-driven agriculture, outpacing many developed regions in real-world applications. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: With 50% of the global youth population, Africa’s tech workforce is expanding faster than anywhere else—supported by 85% mobile penetration. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Africa’s unique challenges drive innovation—like solar-powered microgrids and AI for disease tracking, solutions no other region needs. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Africa isn’t just catching up—it’s redefining what tech can do for the billions left behind. (4 sec)
